source.pages: 参考答案&音频文稿小册 书页111-119（PNG page-001至page-009）：书页114 Listening 答案与 Transcript 起，书页114-119 音频文稿

parts.1:
Test Four. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1  Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
Question 1  One. What did the girl buy today?
Dad: Nice sweater!
Girl: Thanks, Dad. Actually, it's an old one. But I went shopping with Mum today, for some clothes.
Dad: Did you get anything nice? Didn't you need some shoes?
Girl: I didn't see any I liked, but I got this cool dress. I think I'll wear it for Tanya's barbecue party this afternoon.
Dad: Yeah. Maybe take a sweater, too – it'll be cold later.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2  Two. What will the weather be like this afternoon?
Girl: I think it's going to rain – look at the sky, there are lots of dark clouds.
Boy: It doesn't look good at the moment but it's going to stay dry.
Girl: Great. We can still play football this afternoon.
Boy: Well, it's going to be really windy, so maybe not. But I'm sure it'll be sunny again tomorrow.
Girl: I hope so.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3  Three. Where did the girl stay on her holiday?
Boy: How was your holiday?
Girl: Very good. You know Dad loves camping, but Mum wanted to stay in a big hotel this time. Dad wasn't very happy about that, so we booked a guest house with a nice garden instead.
Boy: So, was it better than a tent?
Girl: It was actually. And the place only had two floors.
Boy: Well, I love camping.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4  Four. Which homework has the boy finished?
Boy: Hi, have you finished your homework?
Girl: I've done the maths – that was easy, and I've nearly finished science. What about you?
Boy: I started geography, but got bored, so did all the history exercise and I've almost finished the maths.
Girl: Shall we do our geography together at the library?
Boy: OK, I'll bring my maths book too – we can check our answers.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5  Five. What did the girl do at the weekend?
Boy: Hi, did you have a good weekend?
Girl: Great, thanks. I wanted to go swimming, but there was a competition at the pool all weekend so I couldn't go in.
Boy: So what did you do?
Girl: I won a game of badminton that I played with my sister! And you went sailing. I love that.
Boy: I'm going again next weekend – why don't you come?
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2  Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling her students about a school trip to a glass factory.
Teacher: Now listen everyone. The glass factory trip's on June the twenty-first. That's the same week as Sports Day, which is on the twenty-fifth. Glass factories often make things like glass animals but this one is well-known for its bowls. I've got a lovely one for fruit. You've probably seen the drawing which the factory uses for its adverts. It's a dolphin. But actually, I think it looks a bit like a cloud. You'll need to be at school by eight thirty as the coach goes at eight forty-five. We hope to arrive at the factory around nine forty-five. There's no need to take lunch – we'll have it there in the cafeteria, but please bring your notebooks and remember to leave your phones at home for the day. You can't take them into the factory. For more information contact the new art teacher, Mr Stapely, who's planning everything. That's spelled S-T-A-P-E-L-Y, if you want to find him on the school website.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3  Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a brother and sister, Mark and Jessica, talking about a music festival they went to for the weekend.
Jessica: The music festival was great, wasn't it, Mark?
Mark: It really was, Jessica. I'm glad Mum could drive us there.
Jessica: Yes, it was a long way from a railway station and buses are very slow.
Mark: Next time let's take a tent and camp at the festival.
Jessica: Really? I liked it at Uncle Jim's flat.
Mark: You're right. It was nice – and better than a hotel.
Jessica: Did you enjoy everything at the festival? We were lucky with the weather.
Mark: I know. And it was cheaper than most festivals. It was just too crowded for me.
Jessica: Oh? I enjoyed being with lots of people. What did you think of the singer called Amelia?
Mark: She was so pretty and I loved her songs. And she played the piano so well.
Jessica: Yes, she was beautiful and sang well. I think I liked her best.
Mark: Oh I think that last band we saw was the best.
Jessica: Did you buy that book about them at the festival shop?
Mark: No. But I got chocolates for Mum. And a scarf for me.
Jessica: I got one of those too.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4  Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16  Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about a visitor who gave a talk at their school. What is the visitor's job?
Boy: What did you think of today's speaker?
Girl: Fascinating. He has so many opportunities to travel. I'd love that.
Boy: There are lots of jobs where people can travel. Photographer, for example.
Girl: But he meets so many different people and shows them round really interesting places.
Boy: He had great stories, not like the last speaker, that guy who played the violin – really boring.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17  Seventeen. You will hear two friends talking about a book. What is the girl reading about?
Boy: I love the picture of the lion on the cover of your book.
Girl: It's great! The story's about a teenage girl who travelled across Africa on a motorbike. She saw lots of amazing animals.
Boy: I wouldn't be brave enough to do that.
Girl: She says she's written several songs about her trip. Perhaps she'll be a well-known singer one day?
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18  Eighteen. You will hear a teacher talking to her students. What does she want them to do?
Teacher: OK everyone, it's time to stop what you're doing. Frank, could you collect the books and put them on the shelf near the coats? And Milo, those pens should be on my desk. Everyone else, if you notice any bits of paper on the floor, put them in the bin. Then sit down and start your essays. And no copying!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19  Nineteen. You will hear two friends talking about some homework. How does the girl feel about her homework?
Boy: Have you done that geography project that Mrs Williams gave us for homework?
Girl: Yes. I watched a video online and used some of the points they talked about.
Boy: Oh, I didn't think of doing that.
Girl: Yeah. I found out some things that I'm hoping Mrs Williams will enjoy. I wrote about half a page.
Boy: That's more than I did!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20  Twenty. You will hear a teacher talking to his class about a book. Why is he talking to his class about the book?
Teacher: Can I have your attention, everyone? Look at this book. No, it doesn't belong to any of you. See the name on the cover? Does it look familiar? Mrs Lam was a teacher here, remember? Well, now she's an author. Isn't that interesting? If you'd like to read her book, ask your parents if you can get it.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5  Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Anna talking to her mother about her friend Sophie's house. What does Anna think of each place in Sophie's house?
Mum: Hi, Anna. Did you have fun with Sophie? What's her family's new house like? Does it have a big garden?
Anna: The garden's lovely, Mum, but it's quite small. It's got lots of pretty flowers.
Mum: What did you think of Sophie's bedroom?
Anna: Well, Sophie's different from me – she puts all her books on the shelves and her clothes in the cupboard.
Mum: Not like you at all! Did you see her brother Leo's bedroom?
Anna: Yeah. He's got lots of space, but I didn't think his room was very comfortable.
Mum: And what about the kitchen?
Anna: We didn't stay in there long, because it wasn't very warm. Sophie's mum says they're going to change it. She wants a more modern kitchen.
Mum: What's the living room like?
Anna: I thought the chairs were really nice to sit in, and the carpet's soft. In their old house, the living room was dark, but this one isn't.
Mum: That's good.
Anna: And just before I left, I saw the bathroom. I've never seen one like that before. The colours are so strange.
Mum: It sounds like you saw the whole house!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 女孩今天买了一条很酷的连衣裙，因此选择 C。爸爸问她 "Did you get anything nice? Didn't you need some shoes?"，女孩回答 "I didn't see any I liked, but I got this cool dress"，还打算穿它去 Tanya 的烧烤聚会；毛衣和鞋只是对话中提到的其他衣物（爸爸建议 "Maybe take a sweater, too"），并不是女孩买的东西。
explanations.p1q2: 对话说明下午会刮很大的风，因此选择 B。女孩起初猜 "I think it's going to rain"，男孩说 "it's going to stay dry"，但随后更正 "it's going to be really windy, so maybe not"；下雨和天晴都只是两人先前的猜测，下午真正的天气是大风。
explanations.p1q3: 他们最后预订了带花园的家庭旅馆，因此选择 A。爸爸爱露营、妈妈想住大酒店，但女孩说 "Dad wasn't very happy about that, so we booked a guest house with a nice garden instead"，最终住的是带漂亮花园的家庭旅馆；大酒店和帐篷（"was it better than a tent?"）都是被放弃的方案。
explanations.p1q4: 男孩已经完成了历史作业，因此选择 C。男孩说 "I started geography, but got bored, so did all the history exercise"，历史作业已全部做完；数学只是 "I've almost finished the maths"（接近完成），地理才刚开头，都不算完成。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩周末和姐姐打羽毛球并赢了比赛，因此选择 A。她本想游泳但 "there was a competition at the pool all weekend so I couldn't go in"，帆船是男孩的活动（"And you went sailing"），女孩自己 "won a game of badminton that I played with my sister"，所以正确图是打羽毛球赢比赛。
explanations.p2q1: 答案为 bowls。老师说玻璃厂通常做玻璃动物之类的东西，但 "this one is well-known for its bowls"，还提到自己有一个装水果的玻璃碗，因此这家工厂以碗（bowls）闻名。
explanations.p2q2: 答案为 dolphin。老师说 "You've probably seen the drawing which the factory uses for its adverts. It's a dolphin."，即工厂广告画上画的是海豚；她随后说 "I think it looks a bit like a cloud" 只是形容形状像云，属于干扰信息。
explanations.p2q3: 答案为 8.45。老师说 "You'll need to be at school by eight thirty as the coach goes at eight forty-five."，八点半是到校时间，大巴八点四十五出发才是离开学校的时间；"eight thirty" 是主要干扰，注意区分。
explanations.p2q4: 答案为 notebooks。老师说午餐不用带（"There's no need to take lunch"，在食堂用餐），但 "please bring your notebooks"，且手机必须留在家里（"leave your phones at home"），因此需要带的物品是笔记本。
explanations.p2q5: 答案为 Stapely。老师说 "For more information contact the new art teacher, Mr Stapely"，并逐字母拼读 "S-T-A-P-E-L-Y"，因此联系人姓氏为 Stapely，注意首字母大写和拼写。
explanations.p3q1: 他们很高兴妈妈能开车送他们去，因此选择 B。Mark 说 "I'm glad Mum could drive us there"，Jessica 补充 "it was a long way from a railway station and buses are very slow"，说明坐火车、公交都不方便，他们是坐汽车去的。
explanations.p3q2: Mark 提过下次想带帐篷露营（"Next time let's take a tent and camp at the festival"），但这次他们住在 Uncle Jim 的公寓里，Jessica 说 "I liked it at Uncle Jim's flat"，Mark 也说 "It was nice – and better than a hotel"，因此选择 C；酒店只是比较对象，并非他们的住处。
explanations.p3q3: 天气很好，费用也比大多数音乐节低；Jessica 说 "We were lucky with the weather"，Mark 说 "it was cheaper than most festivals. It was just too crowded for me"，他唯一不满的是现场太拥挤，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q4: 两人都认为 Amelia 很漂亮：Mark 说 "She was so pretty and I loved her songs"，Jessica 说 "she was beautiful and sang well. I think I liked her best"；但 Jessica 最喜欢她，Mark 却认为 "that last band we saw was the best"，所以“最喜欢的音乐人”不是共同看法，共同点是她看起来很棒，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q5: Jessica 也买了一条围巾，是可以穿戴的物品，因此选择 C。Mark 说 "I got chocolates for Mum. And a scarf for me."，Jessica 回答 "I got one of those too"，说明她同样买了围巾；巧克力是 Mark 买给妈妈的，与她无关。
explanations.p4q1: 来访者的工作是导游，因此选择 A。女孩说 "he meets so many different people and shows them round really interesting places"，这正是导游的工作内容；男孩提到的 "Photographer, for example" 只是举例的干扰项，上次拉小提琴的演讲者也与这次来访者无关。
explanations.p4q2: 书讲的是一段激动人心的旅程，因此选择 C。女孩说 "The story's about a teenage girl who travelled across Africa on a motorbike"，一位少女骑摩托车穿越非洲；封面上的狮子（"the picture of the lion on the cover"）和她写的几首歌（"she's written several songs about her trip"）都只是故事细节。
explanations.p4q3: 老师要大家收拾教室，因此选择 A。她让 Frank "collect the books and put them on the shelf near the coats"，让 Milo 把笔放回讲台，还要求把地上的纸屑 "put them in the bin"，这些都是整理教室的任务；之后才 "sit down and start your essays"，且 "And no copying!" 说明不是抄写内容，也没有让大家准备回家，B、C 都不对。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩对自己的作业感到满意，因此选择 A。她说 "I watched a video online and used some of the points they talked about"，还查到了 "some things that I'm hoping Mrs Williams will enjoy"；她只是希望（hoping）老师会喜欢，并非确定，已写了半页也没有担心篇幅不够。
explanations.p4q5: 老师聊这本书是因为作者可能是学生们认识的人，因此选择 C。他说明 "it doesn't belong to any of you"，书不属于任何学生，也不是布置全班共读，而是因为 "Mrs Lam was a teacher here, remember?"，作者曾在本校任教。
explanations.p5q1: Sophie 的卧室对应 G（tidy，整洁）。Anna 说 "she puts all her books on the shelves and her clothes in the cupboard"，书和衣服都收纳得整整齐齐，妈妈也感叹 "Not like you at all!"，可见房间很整洁。
explanations.p5q2: Leo 的卧室对应 B（big，大）。Anna 说 "He's got lots of space"，房间空间很大；同时她觉得 "I didn't think his room was very comfortable"，所以不能选 comfortable。
explanations.p5q3: 厨房对应 C（cold，冷）。Anna 说 "We didn't stay in there long, because it wasn't very warm"，厨房不暖和即偏冷；"modern" 是 Sophie 妈妈想改造后的样子（"She wants a more modern kitchen"），不是现在的特点。
explanations.p5q4: 客厅对应 D（comfortable，舒适）。Anna 说 "the chairs were really nice to sit in, and the carpet's soft"，椅子坐着舒服、地毯柔软；"dark" 指的是老房子的客厅（"In their old house, the living room was dark"），现在的客厅并不暗。
explanations.p5q5: 浴室对应 H（unusual，不寻常）。Anna 说 "I've never seen one like that before. The colours are so strange."，从未见过这样的浴室、颜色很奇怪，因此是 unusual。

conflicts: p2q3: 站内数据 8.30/8:30/eight thirty/half past eight（show 8.30）vs 官方 Key 8.45 / eight forty-five。音频原文 "You'll need to be at school by eight thirty as the coach goes at eight forty-five."：8.30 是到校时间，8.45 才是大巴出发（离开学校）的时间，官方 Key 与题目 'Leave school at' 对应正确。
p4q3: 站内数据 B（copy something into their books）vs 官方 Key A（tidy the classroom）。音频为老师布置收书、放笔、捡纸屑等整理教室的任务，官方 Key 正确；p4q3 解析已按官方 Key 改写为选 A。
